In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] forces '''attacked''' [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] while he was en route to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The attack was nearly successful, but the pirates were intercepted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and a contingent of [[Clone trooper pilot|clone pilot]]s of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. The pirate forces were destroyed and Senator Organa survived to be escorted to Coruscant.
